Syntax: sharpen <weapon>
|
|The SHARPEN skill allows warriors to hone the edge of a weapon using a
|sharpening stone, temporarily boosting its damage.
|
|To use this skill, you must be carrying a sharpening stone in your
|inventory (sold at many smiths and weapon shops). The target weapon
|must be in your inventory and not already sharpened.
|
|On success, the weapon gains a bonus to damage rolls and is marked
|as (Sharp). The edge lasts for a limited time before dulling.
|
|On failure, you risk cutting your finger on the blade.
|
|Sharpened weapons display the (Sharp) tag in your inventory and
|when examined.
|
|Warriors learn this skill at level 12.
|
